Scope: Second CIL developer-tools tranche: source-asset matching, export orchestration and TinyTexEntry codecs. Related native boundaries are recorded separately.
AddressPolicy: Findings with Domain cil use synthetic IDA addresses. metadata.methodBodies.rva denotes the original on-disk CLR method header, not a native callable entry. Native findings have full image-base VAs.

Candidates.Name: Offline source-asset cross-reference
Candidates.Use: Match BAR model/motion/audio payloads with available local source assets by MD5 plus byte length; expose nested BAR path and every match rather than copying to developer shares.
Candidates.AbiAndLifecycle: Reimplement the documented format in a bounded host parser. Native searchers require initialized mutable lists/native file manager, mutate masks, use shared result storage and contain unchecked legacy input paths.
Candidates.Status: Useful offline candidate; no new live trainer option proposed.

Candidates.Name: Texture-animation dependency checker
Candidates.Use: Parse texanm.txt %source references, show missing TM2s and dimensions, export a user-chosen dependency bundle with sanitized basenames.
Candidates.AbiAndLifecycle: Do not directly invoke CIL texanim_export: it writes fixed network paths, relies on a fixed source-prefix length and scans a non-terminated file buffer. Its synthetic address is not callable.
Candidates.Status: Format/workflow evidence; safe standalone implementation would need bounded parsing and explicit destination.

Candidates.Name: TIM2 palette variants and preview
Candidates.Use: Export each supported palette variant with explicit dimensions, swizzle and format metadata; use the native routing to guide a standalone converter and reject unsupported inputs.
Candidates.AbiAndLifecycle: Native encodeImage returns into managed _encodeImage through a CLR MethodDef fixup. It needs constructed TexCommon/AxaBaseName, initialized CLR, mutable source buffers, EntryTex cleanup, and write-flag/path ownership. Existing BMP helper is a limited debug preview.
Candidates.Status: Offline modding candidate, not an injection feature.

Limits: No broad completeness claim: these are individual body findings within the selected connected cluster.
No developer share was contacted and no asset/converter action executed.
MD5+length here is a legacy equality lookup, not a secure identity or provenance guarantee.
Native palette/color-region helpers and external codec internals were not fully reconstructed; no promise of round-trip fidelity for arbitrary textures.
Static defects establish code behavior/unchecked assumptions, not exploitability or observed crashes.
